snip.t: Streptococcus pyogenes (Group A): Non‑purulent cellulitis, erysipelas — Crowded living conditions, lymphatic obstruction
| Erysipelas | Sharply demarcated raised erythema, often on face/legs | Upper dermal involvement, raised borders |
Features: a spreading red, hot, swollen, tender area with ill-defined (cellulitis) or sharp (erysipelas) borders, fever, rigors, malaise, and lymphangitis (red streaks) and regional lymphadenopathy.
